title: InfoGAN Disentanglement on 8 Anisotropic Ring Modes
intuition: Trains InfoGAN (G([z, c_disc, c_cont]), D(x), Q(c|x)) on 8 rotated anisotropic Gaussians on a ring, requiring both 8/8 mode coverage AND disentangled recovery of discrete mode identity (NMI >= 0.85, q_acc >= 0.90) and continuous long-axis position (R^2 >= 0.65).
failure_mode: The generator ignores the continuous latent code c_cont or scrambles discrete codes across modes when adversarial and mutual-information gradients conflict.
